thread:
maya (PM): Quick run-through from design review: two decisions left — pool sorting UX and how prominent Burst should be.
samir (prod-designer): Proposal: default dropdown sort = Recommended (composite latency+cost). Add three tiny chips in dropdown header: Recommended | Cheapest | Most used. chips toggle the list.
tal (frontend): We can't use native select for header chips. Need a custom combobox. keyboard focus must land on the search input first then the chips.
oliver (ux-research): In testing users liked 'Recommended' but wanted an obvious way to switch. chips are discoverable. Make them persistent per-user.
liam (eng-run): Backend will add pool metadata and a 'recommended_score' float. We'll return available_node_sizes too so we can gray-out incompatible pools.
samir (prod-designer): Burst UI idea: show a compact pill on card "Burst: Off" which expands inline to slider + "Enable burst" CTA. avoids accidental toggles.
ana (a11y): Accessibility: make the pill a button with aria-expanded; expanded panel must trap focus and use aria-live to announce cost estimate. don't rely on hover.
tal (frontend): Confirm pattern: user clicks pill -> panel expands -> user adjusts slider -> clicks 'Enable burst (approx. +$X/hr)'. Cancel returns focus to pill.
liam (eng-run): We'll accept burst_enabled and burst_capacity_pct; client can request an approx estimate. API will flag when pool node sizes don't fit model.
ana (a11y): Banner for SLO guardrail should use role=alert and include text+icon. Contrast must be AA. Also prefer 'temporary instances' wording over 'ephemeral'.
samir (prod-designer): Copy tweak: change microcopy to "Temporary instances are billed while running." and show it under burst info.
maya (PM): Save CTA placement: keep Save/Cancel in expanded panel footer. compact card shows 'Edit' to open panel.
tal (frontend): I'll prototype combobox + pill interactions and test keyboard/VO.
deploy-bot: Preview deploy queued: preview/autoscale-pool-sort-pills -> staging. Build #9107.
maya (PM): Thanks all — tag copy nits in Figma and post any a11y regressions here after staging test.
